The four cars are aligned in a perfect row but exhibit slight perspective inconsistencies; the front-most and rear-most cars seem to have slightly different vanishing points relative to the camera angle.
The sheep's front legs show slight blurring and merging at the joints, likely due to motion blur simulation or generation artifacts, making the exact hoof separation unclear.
